findings.observation: Create and move use equivalent resolver methods with operation-owned Project records. Their bridges repeat resolution, resolved-map tracking, collision-list conversion, and result conversion.
findings.impact: Shared project evidence changes require coordinated edits across similar records and adapters. Composition also owns result-enrichment behavior.
findings.recommendation: Consider one internal project observation/resolution contract and explicit create/move workflows. Keep operation-specific output projections. A cohesive resource package or shared contract across separate packages can remove the duplication; folder count is not the criterion.
findings.verification: Preserve create description, move path-unavailable evidence, permission metadata, compact request-ID omission, nil/empty encoding, and successful mutation evidence. Compare navigation and dependency conventions against the other pilots before selecting a target.

findings.observation: Actions discover BeginProjectResolution through an optional interface assertion. Bridges forward it, and the resource adapter stores a lazy inventory/index in context values. The declared Resolver interface does not describe snapshot lifetime.
findings.impact: A replacement resolver can silently change observation consistency and hierarchy-read counts. Maintainers must discover a separate interface and context protocol.
findings.recommendation: Make fresh planning/prewrite phases an explicit injected dependency contract. Context storage can remain an implementation detail. Retain the two phases rather than merging their observations.
findings.verification: Keep one hierarchy read per phase, fresh prewrite observations, effective cancellation, and invocation isolation. Preserve TestProjectMoveUsesOneHierarchyPerValidationPhase and shared hierarchy tests.

findings.observation: The client can return an unknown mutation result alongside a transport error. Bridges discard that result, and actions return zero Output. Requested-field mismatch checks also return zero results after decoding an identity. Move errors still retain the source LUID and request ID through the error contract.
findings.impact: Structured result/plan evidence does not survive every layer. The user-visible consequence has not been reproduced, and total identity loss is not established.
findings.recommendation: Assess a common mutation-outcome contract independently of structural migration. Preserve baseline behavior until a separately approved correction has characterization evidence.
findings.verification: Inject accepted-request transport failure and correct-identity/wrong-field responses. Assert outcome, affected identity, request ID, recovery advice, and no success claim. Review shared error finalization before declaring a defect or suite-wide gap.

findings.observation: The move revalidation test uses immutable resolution results without phase/call assertions. Create's combined test uses static collisions. Its compact request-ID test does not directly assert serialized omission. Other reviewed integration and golden tests protect some of these contracts.
findings.impact: Individual test names imply stronger evidence than their fakes and assertions provide; this is not proof of absent repository-wide coverage.
findings.recommendation: Retain useful tests and strengthen them with phase-specific state, exact rejection/outcome assertions, and serialized projection checks. Map replacement coverage before any consolidation or removal.
findings.verification: Controlled changes to source/destination/collision observations must prevent writes. Mutation of serialized compact request-ID behavior must fail the relevant output test. No mutation testing has run.

test_groups.contract: Preview never mutates; move selects exact parent; descendant moves are rejected.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Unexpected write during preview, wrong destination, or hierarchy cycle.
test_groups.assertions: Preview nil result/zero calls; execution one call and exact parent; descendant case requires an error.
test_groups.limitations: Resolver is immutable and ignores most selectors. No assertion establishes phase freshness, exact source ID, cycle error ID, or zero writes in the cycle case.

test_groups.contract: Preview never creates; execution revalidates parent and collisions before creating.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Changed parent or new sibling collision between planning and mutation.
test_groups.assertions: Preview parent and zero writes; execution one create with parent and returned identity.
test_groups.limitations: Parent changes between separate preview/execute invocations, then repeats within execution. Collision results never change. Does not prove late-collision rejection.

test_groups.contract: Reject conflicting sibling/parent identity; root creation does not invent a parent.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Sequential resolver changes authoritative parent ID or reports existing sibling; parent inference changes root scope.
test_groups.assertions: Error and zero creator calls for rejection; zero parent lookups, empty request parent, and nil plan parent for root.
test_groups.limitations: In-process fakes, not native hierarchy behavior. Rejection test does not assert exact error ID.

test_groups.contract: Reject absent target/name, invalid permission mode, slash name, and conflicting parent selectors.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Invalid typed input reaches workflow execution.
test_groups.assertions: Each invalid input must return an error.
test_groups.limitations: No exact validation/error assertion or explicit no-read/no-write assertion. Full CLI can supply a sole configured target before this boundary.

test_groups.contract: Stable compact/full rendering and omission of successful request diagnostics from compact output.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Projection field omission, addition, or encoding drift.
test_groups.assertions: Golden test compares compact/full TOON; compact test checks identity and details marker.
test_groups.limitations: Constructed output does not exercise workflow. Compact test never explicitly asserts request-ID omission. Referenced golden fixture contents were not independently inspected.
test_groups.disposition: keep golden and relocate with projection owner if moved; strengthen compact assertion or consolidate only with explicit replacement coverage

test_groups.contract: One hierarchy per validation phase and fresh source evidence before mutation.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: TLS server changes source name on the second hierarchy response.
test_groups.assertions: Changed source produces target_changed, nonzero exit, and zero writes; stable source writes once; both cases read twice.
test_groups.limitations: Full app.Run with local TLS, not live Tableau. PUT branch does not validate exact request path/body. No destination/collision drift variant in this test.
test_groups.disposition: keep; strengthen request and additional drift assertions

test_groups.contract: Phase reuse, fresh-phase drift, cancellation, discovery immutability, and live/discovery separation.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Mutable client changes root name; caller mutates returned map; canceled context reaches cached phase.
test_groups.assertions: Twelve concurrent resolutions use one read; fresh phase sees changed path and second read; canceled lookup errors; discovery remains immutable while live/new invocation sees changes.
test_groups.limitations: Stateful in-process client, not HTTP pagination or production race execution. Tests inspected, not run.

test_groups.contract: Sibling-specific case-insensitive collisions and normalization of new identities absent from inventory.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Same name under another parent; mutation response is newer than inventory.
test_groups.assertions: Exact matching sibling/path; retained mutation identity, description, nested path, and root path.
test_groups.limitations: Fixed inventory pages model identity absence, not eventual-consistency timing or HTTP failures.

test_groups.contract: Successful mutation evidence survives unavailable optional hierarchy enrichment.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: TLS fixture marks mutation, then rejects later hierarchy reads with 403; one variant returns an unconfirmed parent.
test_groups.assertions: Create/move preserve path and request ID without postwrite reads; unconfirmed-parent update retains success, empty path, warning, and one failed enrichment read.
test_groups.limitations: Calls runtime methods rather than full CLI/policy/rendering. Scripted native responses, not Tableau state.

test_groups.contract: Return canonical parent path when available and explicit unavailable-path evidence for literal slash names.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Mutation result needs hierarchy enrichment or contains an ambiguous display-path name.
test_groups.assertions: Parent path, parent identity, request ID, or empty path with precise reason.
test_groups.limitations: Fixed client response, not a modeled state mutation or verification failure.
test_groups.disposition: keep; relocate with enrichment owner if moved

test_groups.contract: Exact native request target/fields and preservation of returned mutation evidence.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Wrong HTTP method/path, XML payload, unintended field, or lost explicit empty parent.
test_groups.assertions: Create/update exact escaped paths, XML and headers; absent unrelated fields; request IDs; move parent and top-level XML plus returned parent.
test_groups.limitations: Local TLS with scripted responses, not affected-state storage. Move-specific test lacks path and final request-count assertions.

test_groups.contract: Invalid mutation inputs send no request; malformed or contradictory create responses fail without retry advice.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Missing name/identity/fields, slash names, wrong status, missing project/identity, or mismatched name/parent.
test_groups.assertions: Errors and zero request count for invalid input; protocol error, status, request ID, and nonretryability for bad create responses.
test_groups.limitations: Malformed-response table exercises create only. Unknown or partial structured outcomes across the full CLI are not established by these tests; broader suite coverage remains unassessed.
test_groups.disposition: keep; extend relevant update/move response and outcome cases

test_groups.contract: CLI flags map to typed inputs, preview and top-level remain distinct, and standalone command constructors reject absent required inputs.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Flag wiring drift, selector mixing, or dropped preview flag.
test_groups.assertions: Exact environment/name/parent/permission/preview values, top-level with empty parent selector, and invalid-input errors. Cross-resource tables assessed only for Project cases.
test_groups.limitations: Command spies do not establish global policy, HTTP behavior, or remote effect. Full CLI sole-target preparation is outside standalone constructor tests.
test_groups.disposition: keep at parsing boundary; relocate Project cases only if navigation improves without duplication

test_groups.contract: Full CLI selects the sole configured target before executing create without an environment flag.
test_groups.failure_mechanism: Wrong site binding, repeated setup, or incorrect CLI result identity.
test_groups.assertions: Sign-in site, exact native path, one sign-in, two reads, one create, and rendered environment/site/created identity.
test_groups.limitations: TLS fixture checks body name by substring; no persistent Tableau state. Consent setup helper internals were not assessed here.
